using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.IO;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.IO.Tests
{
    public class FileSystemHelperTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<IFileSystem> _mockFileSystem;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<FileSystemHelper>> _mockLoggerGeneric;

        public FileSystemHelperTests()
        {
            _mockFileSystem = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockLoggerGeneric = new Mock<ILogger<FileSystemHelper>>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteFile_IOException_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            string path = "/test/path/file.txt";
            var ioException = new IOException("Test IO error");
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path)).Throws(ioException);

            // Act
            FileSystemHelper.DeleteFile(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            _mockFileSystem.Verify(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == ioException),
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    ioException,
                    "Error deleting file {Path}",
                    path
                ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteFile_UnauthorizedAccessException_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            string path = "/test/path/file.txt";
            var unauthorizedException = new UnauthorizedAccessException("Access denied");
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path)).Throws(unauthorizedException);

            // Act
            FileSystemHelper.DeleteFile(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            _mockFileSystem.Verify(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == unauthorizedException),
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    unauthorizedException,
                    "Error deleting file {Path}",
                    path
                ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_IOExceptionOnDirectoryDelete_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            string parentPath = "/test/parent";
            string childPath = "/test/parent/child";
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(parentPath))
                .Returns(new[] { childPath });
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetFileSystemEntryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            
            var ioException = new IOException("Directory delete error");
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            
            // Mock static Directory.Delete to throw IOException
            var mockDirectory = new Mock<IDirectoryWrapper>();
            mockDirectory.Setup(d => d.Delete(childPath, false)).Throws(ioException);
            
            // Since Directory.Delete is static, we test the logging behavior through verification
            // by ensuring the method reaches the catch block

            // Act
            FileSystemHelper.DeleteEmptyFolders(_mockFileSystem.Object, parentPath, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex is IOException && ex.Message == "Directory delete error"),
                    "Error deleting directory {Path}",
                    childPath
                ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_UnauthorizedAccessExceptionOnDirectoryDelete_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            string parentPath = "/test/parent";
            string childPath = "/test/parent/child";
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(parentPath))
                .Returns(new[] { childPath });
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetFileSystemEntryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());

            var unauthorizedException = new UnauthorizedAccessException("Access denied on directory");
            
            // Act & Assert - the static Directory.Delete call will throw and be caught
            // We verify the logger was called with the specific message for IOException case
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<UnauthorizedAccessException>(),
                    "Error deleting directory {Path}",
                    childPath
                ), Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Wrapper interface for testing static Directory.Delete calls
    public interface IDirectoryWrapper
    {
        void Delete(string path, bool recursive);
    }
}

            FileSystemHelper.DeleteFile(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockLogger.Object);

            _mockFileSystem.Verify(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    unauthorizedException,
                    "Error deleting file {Path}",
                    path
                ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_IOExceptionOnDirectoryDelete_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            string parentPath = "/test/parent";
            string childPath = "/test/parent/child";
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(parentPath))
                .Returns(new[] { childPath });
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetFileSystemEntryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());

            // Create a test directory that we can delete to trigger IOException
            var testDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            Directory.CreateDirectory(testDir);
            
            try
            {
                // Make it non-empty to avoid recursive delete issues
                File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(testDir, "test.txt"), "test");
                
                // Act - Directory.Delete will throw IOException for non-empty dir
                FileSystemHelper.DeleteEmptyFolders(_mockFileSystem.Object, parentPath, _mockLogger.Object);
            }
            finally
            {
                try { Directory.Delete(testDir, true); } catch { }
            }

            // Assert - verify logger was called (actual path will be testDir, not childPath)
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<IOException>(ex => ex.HResult != 0),
                    "Error deleting directory {Path}",
                    It.IsAny<string>()
                ), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_NoExceptions_NoErrorLogged()
        {
            // Arrange
            string parentPath = "/test/parent";
            string childPath = "/test/parent/child";
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(parentPath))
                .Returns(new[] { childPath });
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(childPath))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetFileSystemEntryPaths(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());

            // Create empty test directories
            var testParent = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            var testChild = Path.Combine(testParent, "child");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(testParent);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(testChild);
            
            try
            {
                // Act
                FileSystemHelper.DeleteEmptyFolders(_mockFileSystem.Object, parentPath, _mockLogger.Object);
            }
            finally
            {
                try { Directory.Delete(testParent, true); } catch { }
            }

            // Assert - no error logged
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ), Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
